Name: Underloft Hiker
Information:
**Underloft Hiker**

Underloft hikers are designed to stand guard over or explore cave-like environments. They easily traverse sheer surfaces, and stay out of sight until they strike targets with compressed bursts of pure arcane power.

**Constructed Nature.** The underloft hiker doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.

Stat Blocks.title: Underloft Hiker
languages: understands the languages of its creator but can’t speak

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The construct uses its Strike twice or its Force Shatter once.

actions.name: Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 3) piercing damage plus 4 (1d6) poison damage.

actions.name: Force Shatter
actions.description: One creature of the construct’s choice that it can see within 60 feet is assailed with a burst of energy, and must make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking 21 (4d8 + 3) force damage and is knocked prone on a failure. If this action is taken while the construct is hidden from its target, the target has disadvantage on their save against it.

bonus_actions.name: Underaction
bonus_actions.description: While it is within dim light or is partially obscured, the construct takes the Hide action.

reactions.name: Drop
reactions.description: When the construct would take falling damage, it takes less damage as though it had fallen 100 fewer feet than it did.
